c1-jas-0008: James pictures two visitors walking into the assembly, one poor and one finely dressed. Let's read James 2:2.
c2-jas-0002: James warns those who plan to go to a city and make a profit. Let's turn to James 4:14.
c2-jas-0003: James describes giving the well-dressed visitor a good place. Let's look at James 2:3 and 4 together.
c2-jas-0004: James says the wages kept back by fraud are crying out. Let's read James 5:3 and 4.
c3-jas-0001: James asks, "Is anyone among you sick?" Let's open James 5:13 and 14.
c3-jas-0002: James calls on the wealthy to weep and howl. Let's read James 2:5 and 5:1.
c3-jas-0003: James says, "Draw near to God and He will draw near to you." Let's check James 4:8 and 5:16.
c3-jas-0004: James says that knowing the good and leaving it undone is sin. Let's dig into James 2:10 and 4:17.
c1-1pe-0002: Peter tells the elders to shepherd the flock until the Chief Shepherd appears. Let's read First Peter 5:4.
c2-1pe-0006: Peter tells believers to be hospitable to one another. Let's go to First Peter 4:9.
c2-1pe-0007: Peter says no one should suffer as a murderer, a thief, or an evildoer. Let's read First Peter 4:15 and 16.
c2-1pe-0008: Peter tells elders to shepherd the flock willingly, not by compulsion. Read First Peter 5:2 and 3 with me.
c3-1pe-0003: Peter says it is God's will that believers do good. Let's read First Peter 2:14 and 15.
c3-1pe-0004: Peter calls believers bondservants of God. Let's look closely at First Peter 2:16 and 4:10.
c3-1pe-0005: Peter says those who revile your conduct may end up ashamed. Let's read First Peter 2:12 and 3:16.
c3-1pe-0006: Peter tells elders to be examples to the flock. Let's turn to First Peter 3:13 and 5:3.
c1-1jn-0002: John has a word for his little children about the time they are living in. Let's read First John 2:18.
c2-1jn-0006: John says the anointing believers received from Him abides in them. Let's open First John 2:27.
c2-1jn-0007: John writes about some who went out from among the believers. Let's read First John 2:19 and 26.
c2-1jn-0008: John speaks of a heart that condemns us, and of God who is greater than our heart. Let's check First John 3:20 and 21.
c3-1jn-0003: John says believers ought to lay down their lives for the brethren. Let's read First John 3:16 and 17.
c3-1jn-0004: Take heart: we have an Advocate with the Father. Let's dig into First John 2:1 and 3:8.
c3-1jn-0005: John names the liar as the one who denies the Father and the Son. Let's read First John 2:22 and 4:4.
c3-1jn-0006: We know He abides in us by the Spirit He has given us. Let's go to First John 3:24 and 4:6.
c1-eph-0007: Paul says not to grieve the Holy Spirit of God. Let's read Ephesians 4:30.
c2-eph-0001: Paul has a word for the Ephesians as dear children. Read Ephesians 5:1 with me.
c2-eph-0002: Paul tells believers to put away lying and speak truth with a neighbor. Let's read Ephesians 4:25 and 26.
c2-eph-0003: Paul warns that the wrath of God comes upon the sons of disobedience. Let's look closely at Ephesians 5:6 and 7.
c3-eph-0002: Paul tells believers to speak to one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs. Let's read Ephesians 5:19 and 20.
c3-eph-0003: Christ loved the church and gave Himself for her. Let's turn to Ephesians 5:2 and 5:25.
c3-eph-0004: Paul says to put on the new man, created in true righteousness and holiness. Let's read Ephesians 4:24 and 5:27.
c3-eph-0005: Paul tells fathers not to provoke their children to wrath. Let's open Ephesians 4:31 and 6:4.
c1-jud-0001: Jude opens his letter by calling himself a bondservant of Jesus Christ. Let's read Jude 1:1.
c2-jud-0001: Jude says Enoch prophesied about these men. Let's check Jude 1:14.
c2-jud-0002: Jude pronounces woe on men who ran greedily in the error of Balaam and perished in the rebellion of Korah. Let's read Jude 1:11 and 16.
c2-jud-0003: Jude says there would be mockers in the last time. Let's dig into Jude 1:18 and 19.
c3-jud-0001: Jude asks the beloved to remember a warning that was spoken before. Let's read Jude 1:17 and 18.
c3-jud-0002: Jude tells believers to keep themselves while looking for mercy. Let's go to Jude 1:21 and 24.
c3-jud-0003: Jude urges his readers to contend earnestly, and he recalls Enoch's words about the Lord coming with His saints. Let's read Jude 1:3 and 15.
c3-jud-0004: Jude prays that mercy, peace, and love be multiplied. Let's look at Jude 1:2 and 20 together.
